article.title: Anthropic整合Claude Chat與Cowork，AI自行決定如何完成任務
article.summary: Anthropic周三（9/16）宣布整合Claude Chat與Cowork，未來使用者不必再選擇一般聊天或Cowork工作模式，只要向Claude提出需求，系統就會自行判斷如何完成任務。新功能將於未來幾周率先開放Pro與Max方案使用。

article.title: Mark your calendars: A Googlebook ‘celebration’ is happening next month
article.summary: Credit: Google TL;DR Google will be hosting an event in New York City next month. This event will be where the company shows off the first wave of Googlebooks. The show, called Opening Night, will take place on October 5. On Monday, Google finally revealed when you’ll be able to start pre-ordering its new category of laptops, known as Googlebooks. The company has revealed hardly any information about this new hardware to date. But we won’t have to wait that much longer to finally start getting some details. According to Engadget , Google has begun sending out invites to an upcoming event called “Opening Night.” The event is scheduled for October 5 and will take place in New York City.
